title: AI Park Design Challenge — Al Safa 2 Park
description: Dubai Municipality AI Park Design Challenge — 15,000 sqm park redevelopment in Al Safa 2, AED 35M budget. Concept + Preliminary Design, 2-person team, free/open-source tools only. AI must be documented at every stage (worth 20% alone). Submission deadline extended to 21 Sep 2026 (was 15 Aug 2026). Portal opened 28 Jun 2026, query deadline 5 Aug 2026.

children.label: Brief Intake & Setup
children.description: Get grounded and locked in before touching design work.

children.label: Read Schedules 1–7
children.description: Site brief, deliverables, eligibility, evaluation matrix.

children.label: Lock Free Tool Stack
children.description: QGIS, FreeCAD+BlenderBIM, Rhino+Grasshopper edu (Ladybug/Honeybee), ChatGPT/Gemini free tier, Stable Diffusion/Bing, Blender.

children.label: Start AI Methodology Log
children.description: Date, tool, prompt, output, human correction, value added — from day one.

children.label: Prep Team Registration Info
children.description: Names, discipline, role, contact, Emirates ID, photo.

children.label: Site & User Analysis
children.description: Understand the ground and the people before designing anything.

children.label: On-Foot Site Audit
children.description: Photos, laser meter, Polycam scan.

children.label: QGIS Basemap
children.description: OpenStreetMap + free satellite + open DEM.

children.label: Climate Data Pull
children.description: Open-Meteo API for sun, wind, temperature.

children.label: Opportunities & Constraints Map
children.description: Synthesize audit + GIS + climate findings.

children.label: Community Survey
children.description: Free Google Forms, ~30–50 respondents.

children.label: AI-Assisted Personas
children.description: Children, youth, families, older adults, People of Determination — human-reviewed.

children.label: Accessibility Needs Mapping
children.description: Translate personas into concrete access requirements.

children.label: AI-Driven Analysis & Concept
children.description: Core AI-scored stage — analysis into a chosen direction.

children.label: QGIS Suitability Overlay
children.description: Weighted overlay for zones — play, quiet, gathering, planting.

children.label: AI Criteria Cross-Check
children.description: Weight overlay against community priorities, log overrides.

children.label: AI-Assisted SWOT & Decision Log
children.description: 2–3 candidate directions, human review, recorded reasoning.

children.label: AI Moodboards
children.description: 3 directions via Stable Diffusion/Bing, prompt-refined.

children.label: Design Vision & Narrative
children.description: Concept statement tying findings to identity.

children.label: Concept Massing (IFC)
children.description: Block chosen concept in shared FreeCAD/BlenderBIM model.

children.label: Concept-Level Strategies
children.description: Landscape, sustainability, accessibility — draft resolution.

children.label: Environmental Scenario Testing
children.description: Simulate, interpret, and respond — not raw output alone.

children.label: Ladybug Sun & Shade Study
children.description: Solar exposure and shading on the concept massing.

children.label: AI Comfort & ROM Cost Read
children.description: Plain-language commentary against AED 35M, human-verified.

children.label: Design Response to Findings
children.description: Adjust shading/planting/circulation; log what changed and why.

children.label: Preliminary Design Development
children.description: Coordinated, buildable-resolution design package.

children.label: Detailed Masterplan & Flows
children.description: Spatial organization, zoning, user-journey diagrams.

children.label: Landscape & Planting Plans
children.description: AI-shortlisted palette, verified for local availability.

children.label: Play, Community & Social Spaces
children.description: Playgrounds, plaza, picnic and seating areas.

children.label: Circulation & Accessibility
children.description: Pedestrian, jogging track, universal-access detailing.

children.label: Amenities & Commercial Map
children.description: Services plan plus Commercial & Service Facilities Map.

children.label: Smart Tech & Data Strategy
children.description: Monitoring and data-driven park management opportunities.

children.label: Detailed Sustainability Strategy
children.description: Water, energy, nature-based solutions at full resolution.

children.label: Feasibility & Budget Check
children.description: Cross-check scope/materials against AED 35M budget.

children.label: Preliminary Phasing Plan
children.description: Implementation sequence and maintenance approach.

children.label: Deliverables Assembly
children.description: Package everything Schedule 2 requires — 16 items total.

children.label: Executive Summary
children.description: Vision, concept, and key innovations.

children.label: Narrative & Analysis Docs
children.description: Design narrative, site analysis, user/community analysis.

children.label: AI Methodology Report
children.description: Compiled from the running AI log.

children.label: Masterplan & Landscape Docs
children.description: Masterplan, landscape plans, accessibility & sustainability strategies.

children.label: CAD/BIM Drawings
children.description: Concept diagrams, sections, and elevations.

children.label: Renders & Concept Video
children.description: Day/night renders, full presentation, 1-min AI-assisted animation.

children.label: Additional Supporting Materials
children.description: Anything else needed to communicate the proposal.

children.label: Final Review & Submission
children.description: Score, tighten, and upload before the deadline.

children.label: Internal Evaluation-Matrix Review
children.description: Score against all 6 Schedule 7 criteria, fix weak spots.

children.label: Finalize Team Info
children.description: Confirm Schedule 3 details for portal registration.

children.label: Review IP Terms
children.description: Understand Schedule 6 rights transfer before submitting.

children.label: Upload to Portal
children.description: Submit complete package before 21 September 2026.
